Bellscoin (BELLS) is a decentralized cryptocurrency inspired by “Bells” from Animal Crossing. Created by Billy Markus (Dogecoin co-founder), it uses the Scrypt algorithm and is merged-mind with Litecoin/Dogecoin, offering a secure, transparent digital currency
